limitations: Smooth strictly convex planar bodies with positive curvature only. The controlled metric is curvature-radius negative-Sobolev deviation; constants are not optimal. Scientific rejection is on value after prior structural coverage, not on correctness.
provenance: The mathematical claim, proof, cited literature and reproducibility artifacts are documented in this package; the fresh independent assessment is recorded in the dated audit files.
record_title: Global curvature-radius stability for the planar fractional-perimeter maximum
